author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs a wheel you control with equal slices, a natural OBS spin, short winner messages on every platform, and a result card.
changelog: 4.1.64: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.64, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with two-to-ten equal choices, server-authoritative selection, studded wheel animation, moderator command control, platform-bounded winner messages, and cropped browser-source support.

manifest.name: Prize Wheel
installationSteps: Add the hosted Prize Wheel browser source to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs.
Choose the spin command in the wizard. It registers automatically for moderators and the broadcaster after restart.
Enter two through ten unique wheel choices, choose chat destinations, save, enable, and send a preview.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling keeps only the time of the last spin and the winning choice.

healthChecks.description: Checks that choices stay within limits, spins run one at a time, winners are announced after the spin, and the wheel overlay works.
